description: Check whether a business name looks available in a US state: searches the state's business register (live in Alaska, Colorado, Connecticut, District of Columbia, Florida, Iowa, New York, Oregon, Pennsylvania and Texas; other states return the official search link), whether the .com is registered, and words that often need a regulator's approval. Returns the closest registered names, the official state search URL and a link to the full result.

name.description: The business name to check, e.g. "Blue Ridge Coffee"

state.description: Two-letter code or full name of the US state, e.g. "TX" or "Texas"

name: check_business_name
title: Check a business name
